citation: Bakker (2013). Semi-analytic modeling of transient multi-layer flow with TTim. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10040-013-0975-2. Steady method: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0022-1694(02)00319-0
description: timflow is the project's Python model for groundwater flow through multiple aquifers and leaky layers. It combines the earlier TimML and TTim packages into steady and transient analytic-element modules. Inputs define aquifer properties and analytic elements; outputs are groundwater head, flow and inter-aquifer leakage evaluated at chosen locations and times. The transient calculation solves in the Laplace domain and numerically converts back to time. Coverage is the specified aquifer system, without a fixed geographic extent or observation period. MIT source is free through GitHub and PyPI. A limitation is that model assumptions and selected elements must represent the aquifer adequately; semi-analytic calculations are not field observations. The package supports groundwater-supply and drainage simulations. FEHM (model-fehm) provides a related numerical alternative. The README documents Python 3.11 or later and cites the underlying steady and transient methods.
